data.name: Damned
data.description: When you are killed, your soul is instantly claimed by the Abyss. In time, your soul is transformed into a demon appropriate to the greatest sins you gloried in while you lived. Any character attempting to resurrect a you must succeed at a DC %1 caster level check or the spell fails. That character cannot attempt to resurrect you again until the following day.|10+DemoniacLVL
